nodes.procedure: First, the commercial Ni foam (1 cm × 4 cm) was cleaned for 10 min with a 1 M HCl aqueous solution, absolute ethanol, and deionized water, one after the other, then placed vertically into a 25 mL Teflon autoclave.

nodes.source_text: First, the commercial Ni foam (1 cm × 4 cm) was cleaned for 10 min with a 1 M HCl aqueous solution, absolute ethanol, and deionized water, one after the other, then placed vertically into a 25 mL Teflon autoclave.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal NiMoO4 synthesis
nodes.procedure: 15 ml of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (0.04 M) and (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O (0.01 M) aqueous solution was transferred into the above Teflon autoclave. The autoclave was sealed and heated at 150°C for 6 h in a drying oven to obtain NiMoO4·xH2O microrods grown on Ni foam (NiMoO4·xH2O/NF).

nodes.name: NC coating and nitridation
nodes.procedure: Lastly, the NiMoO4·xH2O/NF and 40 mg dicyandiamide in a porcelain boat were wrapped by copper foil and calcined in Ar atmosphere at 750°C for 2 h with a heating rate of 5°C min⁻¹. After that, black N-doped carbon-coated Ni3Mo3N microrods on Ni foam (NC/Ni3Mo3N/NF) were obtained when the tube furnace was naturally cooled. The product was washed several times with deionized water and ethanol and then dried at 60°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern shows diffraction peaks at 40.7°, 43.0°, 43.7°, 45.2°, and 58.9° attributed to the (221), (310), (103), (311), and (411) planes of Ni₃Mo₃N (JCPDS, No. 49-1336) for NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD pattern shown in Fig. 1d indicated that the diffraction peaks at 40.7°, 43.0°, 43.7°, 45.2°, and 58.9° were attributed to the (221), (310), (103), (311), and (411) planes of Ni₃Mo₃N (JCPDS, No. 49-1336), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show rough and porous microrods of NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF with diameters of 1-2 μm and lengths of 10 μm, consisting of nanoparticles ranging from 40 to 100 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM images in Fig. 1b indicated that rough and porous microrods with diameters of 1-2 μm and lengths of 10 μm were uniformly and vertically grown on Ni foam. The porous microrods were consisted of numerous nanoparticles ranging in size from 40 to 100 nm.

properties.features: porous fibrillar structure, nanofibers, scale bar 1 µm

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows porous microrod structure of NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF with HRTEM crystal plane spacing of 0.2 nm corresponding to the (311) plane of Ni₃Mo₃N and amorphous carbon layer thickness of 2.5 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM images in Fig. 1h indicated that the NC/Ni₃Mo₃N microrod showed a crystal plane spacing of 0.2 nm, which was related to the (311) plane of Ni₃Mo₃N. In addition, amorphous carbon layer with thickness of about 2.5 nm was observed on the surface of the Ni₃Mo₃N microrods.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping of NC/Ni₃Mo₃N shows uniformly distributed signals of Ni, Mo, N, and C with wider distribution widths of N and C confirming N-doped carbon coating.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS mapping of NC/Ni₃Mo₃N (Fig. 1i) clearly showed uniformly distributed signals of Ni, Mo, N, and C in the rod-shaped morphology. However, the distribution widths of N and C were wider than those of Ni and Mo, confirming the presence of the N-doped carbon coating on the Ni₃Mo₃N microrods.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms presence of Ni, Mo, N, C in NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF; Ni 2p shows Ni(0) at 852.8/870.0 eV plus Ni 2p3/2 at 855.9 eV, Ni 2p1/2 at 873.7 eV; Mo 3d shows Mo(0) at 227.6/230.8 eV, Mo²⁺ at 228.1/231.3 eV, Mo⁶⁺ at 232/235.1 eV; N 1s shows N-metal at 397.8 eV, Mo 3p at 393.8 eV, pyrrolic N at 399.8 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS survey scan (Fig. 2a) confirmed the presence of Ni, Mo and O elements in both... and N element was detected only in the NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF. Fig. 2b showed high-resolution XPS of Ni 2p... at 852.8 eV and 870.0 eV. Fig. 2c showed... Mo²⁺ with peaks at 228.1 eV and 231.3 eV... Mo (0) with peaked at 227.6 eV and 230.8 eV... XPS peaks of N 1s were detected... at 397.8 eV, 393.8 eV, and 399.8 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical double-layer capacitance Cdl = 230.24 mF cm⁻² for NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF indicating large electrochemical surface area.
nodes.evidence_snippet: NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF had a high Cdl value of 230.24 mF cm⁻², which was larger than those of NF (4.25 mF cm⁻²), NiMoO₄·xH₂O/NF (1.996 mF cm⁻²), and Ni₃Mo₃N–NH₃/NF (88.16 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows Rs of 2.66 Ω and Rct of 4.8 Ω at 130 mV overpotential for NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the resistance (Rs) values of NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF (2.66 Ω)... the lowest charge-transfer resistance (Rct) of NC/Ni₃Mo₃N/NF was only 4.8 Ω at an overpotential of 130 mV.
